_comment: Disabled routes are excluded from the listing even with a valid override entry; every config entry still validates. Baseline rejects [capabilities] at startup.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[[models]]
name = "m-off"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
enabled = false

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".tools]
supported = true

[capabilities.overrides."m-off".reasoning]
supported = true
name: m4_capability_override_disabled_excluded
